senses.gloss: जीव- + आत्मन् जीव- + आत्मन्, m. the individual soul, Bhāg. P. 6, 16, 2.
जीवित- + ईश जीवित- + ईश, m. a name of Yama, Ragh. 11, 20.
जीव-ग्राह + म् जीव-ग्राह + म् (absol. of ग्रह्), combined with ग्रह्, to take somebody prisoner alive, MBh. 3, 14918.

जीव् जीव्, i. 1, Par. (also Ātm., MBh. 1, 5913).
 1. To live, Man. 2, 235.
 2. To return to life, Bhāg. P. 4, 6, 51.
 3. To maintain one's self, Man. 10, 112; with the instr. 3, 152; with the loc. MBh. 5, 1059.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the pres. अ-जीवन्त्, Unable to subsist, Man. 10, 81.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. [] pass. जीवित,
 1. Living, Ragh. 12, 75.
 2. Revived, Pañc. 221, 8.
 3. Enlivened, Rām. 5, 66, 24. n.
 1. Life, Man. 6, 45.
 2. Livelihood, Hit. i. d. 85.
 --Comp.
 अ-, n. death.
 अन्-अपेक्षित- (vb. ईक्ष्), adj. regardless of life, Kathās. 18, 374.
 स-, adj. still living, Rājat. 5, 58.
 हत- (vb. हन्),
 I. adj. desponding.
 II. n. despair.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass.
 I. जीव्य, n. Life, Hariv. 14376.
 II. जीवितव्य, n.
 1. Possibility of living, Pañc. 76, 13.
 2. Life, Pañc. 221, 6.
 III. जीवनीय, n. Epithet of milk; perhaps, Just milked, still warm, Suśr. 1, 175, 14.
 --Caus.
 I. जीवय (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 3, 16230),
 1. To revive, MBh. 1, 1995.
 2. To let live, MBh. 3, 870.
 3. To bring up, MBh. 1, 6152.
 II. जीवापय, To revive, Lass. 18, 8.
 --Desid. जिजीविष,
 1. To wish to live, MBh. 4, 615.
 2. To gain one's livelihood, Man. 10, 121.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, To imitate the life of (with the acc.), Ragh. 19, 15.
 2. To live in conformance with, Rām. 6, 5, 7.
 3. To live for (with the acc.) MBh. 8, 3388.
 4. To maintain one's self by (with the acc.) Rām. 5, 2, 35.
 --Caus. जीवय, To revive, Daśak. in Chr. 187, 9.
 --With आ आ,
 1. To maintain one's self by (with the acc.), MBh. 5, 4536.
 2. To use, Yājñ. 2, 67.
 --With उद् उद्, To return to life, MBh. 12, 5675.
 --With अभ्युद् अभि-उद्, To live as chief, MBh. 5, 4538.
 --With प्रत्युद् प्रति-उद्, To return to life, Kathās. 10, 97.
 --Caus. To revive, Pañc. 244, 2.
 --With उप उप,
 1. To maintain one's self by (with the acc.), Man. 9, 105.
 2. To apply to one's own use, Man. 3, 52.
 3. To gain, Man. 4, 200.
 4. To practise, Bhāg. P. 7, 13, 7. उपजीव्य, That by which one maintains one's self, Yājñ. 2, 227. n. Livelihood, Rām. 2, 37, 25. []
 --With वि वि, To return to life, MBh. 1, 2002.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To live, MBh. 3, 3054.
 2. To return to life, Draup. 9, 4.
 --Caus. जीवय,
 1. To animate, Man. 1, 57.
 2. To revive, Rām. 4, 51, 20.
 3. To preserve, Rājat. 2, 28.
 --With प्रतिसम् प्रति-सम्, To return to life, Rām. 5, 28, 16.
 --Cf. βίος, βίοτος (= जीवथ), βείομαι, βιόμεσθα, etc.; Lat. vivo; Goth. quivs; A.S. cwic; Goth. ga-quivjan, etc.

जीव जीव् + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Living, MBh. 13, 31.
 2. Causing life, Bhāg. P. 9, 21, 13.
 II. m. and n.
 1. Creature, MBh. 13, 13828.
 2. Life, Rām. 5, 3, 74.
 III. m. The individual soul, Vedāntas. in Chr. 207, 6.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. βίος; Lat. vivus; Goth. qvivs.

जीवक जीव् + अक,
 I. latter part of comp. adj. Maintaining one's self by, MBh. 13, 6455.
 II. m. A medicinal plant, considered as one of the eight principal drugs, Suśr. 1, 59, 16.
 III. f. विका,
 1. Life, Man. 4, 11.
 2. A means of subsistence, Man. 10, 76; Bhāg. P. 7, 13, 7.
 --Comp.
जीवजीवक जीवजीवक, m. A kind of bird, Man. 12, 66.
जीवंजीव जीवंजीव, i. e. जीव + म्-जीव, and जीवंजीविक जीवंजीविक, i. e. जीव + म्-जीव + इक, m. A kind of pheasant, MBh. 3, 8702.

जीवथ जीव् + अथ, m. Life.
 --Cf. βίοτος.

जीवन जीव् + अन,
 I. adj., f. नी, Animating, [] enlivening, MBh. 1, 3241.
 II. n. Life, Rām. 4, 19, 19.
 2. Subsistence, Man. 11, 76.
 3. A means of subsistence, MBh. 3, 13724.
 4. Revivification, Rām. 6, 105.
 --Comp.
जीवनता जीवन + ता, f. Conduct, Lass. 88, 15.
जीवन्ती जीवन्ती, i. e. जीवन्त्, ptcple. pres. of जीव्, + अ + ई, f. A vegetable and medicinal plant, MBh. 2, 98.
जीवमय जीव + मय, adj., f. यी, Living, Bhāg. P. 9, 9, 24.
जीवल जीवल, m. A proper name, Nal. 15, 7.
जीववन्त् जीव + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Living, MBh. 8, 4930.
जीवातु जीव् + आतु (m. and n.?), Life, Mṛcch. 172, 2.

जीविन् जीव् + इन्,
 I. adj., f. नी.
 1. Living, Man. 9, 246.
 2. Subsisting on, Rām. 1, 9, 61; especially latter part of comp. words, e. g. कृषि-, adj. Supporting one's self by tillage, Man. 3, 165.
 II. m. A living being, Pañc. 68, 15.
 --Comp.
जीवित- + नाथ जीवित- + नाथ, m. a husband, Kumāras. 4, 3.
जीव- + पुत्र जीव- + पुत्र, adj. one of whom a son or children are alive.

जीव- + पुष्प जीव- + पुष्प,
 I. n. 1. the flower of life, denoting a certain plant and the head. 2. the name of two plants.
 II. f. पा, the name of a plant.
जीव- + मात्र जीव- + मात्र, n. germ alone, Pañc. 200, 12 (with न, not even a germ).
जीवन्मुक्त जीवन्म्˚ i. e. जीवन्त्-, [] m. one who has obtained final beatitude during his life, Vedāntas. in Chr. 218, 10.
जीव- + योनि जीव- + योनि, adj. containing life, Bhāg. P. 3, 9, 19.
जीव- + रक्त जीव- + रक्त, n. the blood of the menses, Suśr. 1, 43, 19.
जीव- + लोक जीव- + लोक, m. 1. the world of living beings, i. e. the earth, Pañc. 226, 6. 2. mankind, people, Pañc. i. d. 9.
जीव- + लौकिक जीव- + लौकिक, adj. belonging to the human world, MBh. 12, 8495.
जीव- + शेष जीव- + शेष, adj. having saved only the bare life, Pañc. 160, 2.
जीव- + शोणित जीव- + शोणित, n. living, i. e. sound blood. [] Suśr. 2, 193, 9.
जीव- + संज्ञ जीव- + संज्ञ, adj. called life, Man. 12, 13.
जीव- + सुत जीव- + सुत, adj. one who has living children, Bhāg. P. 6, 19, 25.
